"""Check retained paired sensor fixtures,source bytes and human documentation."""

import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/coupled-counterfactual-noise-v1'
source=root/'audit-v1.json';public=repo/'docs/results/coupled-counterfactual-noise-v1.json'
assert source.read_bytes()==public.read_bytes();data=read(source)
assert data['status']=='pass-independent-physical-moments-and-coupled-data-construction'
assert data['actual_CPU_tests']==16 and data['new_neural_forwards']==data['model_updates']==0
assert data['Poisson_sampler_calls_excluding_tests']==12 and data['Gaussian_sampler_calls_excluding_tests']==4
for item in data['source_bindings']:
    assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original']
    assert ref(item['frozen']['path'])['sha256']==item['frozen']['sha256']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['frozen']['path']).read_bytes()
    assert Path(item['frozen']['path']).read_text()==item['frozen']['text']
assert ref(data['audit']['path'])['sha256']==data['audit']['sha256'] and Path(data['audit']['path']).read_text()==data['audit']['text']
channels=scalars=0;maximum=0.
for row in data['rows']:
    assert ref(row['fixture']['path'])==row['fixture']
    arrays=dict(np.load(row['fixture']['path']));assert len(arrays)==4
    assert all(v.dtype==np.float32 and v.shape==(262144,) and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in arrays.values())
    x,y=arrays['pre_ADC_a'].astype(np.float64),arrays['pre_ADC_b'].astype(np.float64)
    actual={'means':[float(np.mean(x)),float(np.mean(y))],'variances':[float(np.var(x)),float(np.var(y))],
        'covariance':float(np.cov(x,y,bias=True)[0,1]),'difference_variance':float(np.var(y-x))}
    for key,values in actual.items():
        values=values if isinstance(values,list) else [values]
        previous=row['observed_pre_ADC'][key];previous=previous if isinstance(previous,list) else [previous]
        for a,b in zip(values,previous,strict=True):
            difference=abs(a-b);maximum=max(maximum,difference);assert difference<1e-15;scalars+=1
    for member in ['a','b']:
        before=arrays['pre_ADC_'+member]
        expected=(np.clip(before,0,1)*65535).round()/65535
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(arrays['noisy_'+member],expected);channels+=len(expected)
assert channels==2097152 and scalars==24
docs=['docs/coupled-counterfactual-noise.md','diary/2026-11-07-02-22-11-coupled-counterfactual-noise.md',
      'docs/index.md','docs/research.md'];links=0
output=repo/'docs/results/coupled-counterfactual-noise-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
for name in docs:
    p=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        target=(p.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert target==output or target.is_file(),(name,link);links+=1
save(output,{'status':'pass-source-fixture-moment-ADC-and-document-bindings','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'audit':ref(public),'source_pairs':3,'retained_pair_fixtures':4,'actual_CPU_tests':16,
    'pre_ADC_scalar_checks':scalars,'maximum_scalar_difference':maximum,'exact_ADC_values_checked':channels,
    'document_links_checked':links,'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'model_updates':0,
    'scope':'No sampling in this verifier. Reloads all original paired fixture bytes,reduces saved pre-ADC means/variances/covariance/difference variance and checks every saved16-bit ADC value. Source/test/sensor text bytes preserved. Separate synthetic construction evidence,not model quality or part of V159.'})
